# genesyscloud_quality_miner (Resource)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/resources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Genesys Cloud Quality Miner (Intent or Topic). A miner has no update API, so changing any argument will drop and recreate the miner with a new ID.

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this resource. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [GET /api/v2/languageunderstanding/miners](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-languageunderstanding-miners)
* [POST /api/v2/languageunderstanding/miners](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#post-api-v2-languageunderstanding-miners)
* [DELETE /api/v2/languageunderstanding/miners/{minerId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#delete-api-v2-languageunderstanding-miners--minerId-)
* [GET /api/v2/languageunderstanding/miners/{minerId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-languageunderstanding-miners--minerId-)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `languageUnderstanding:miner:add`
* `languageUnderstanding:miner:delete`
* `languageUnderstanding:miner:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `language-understanding`
* `language-understanding:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "genesyscloud_quality_miner" "example_miner" {
  name       = "Example Topic Miner"
  miner_type = "Topic"
  language   = "en-US"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `miner_type` (String) Type of the miner. Changing this attribute will cause the miner to be dropped and recreated with a new ID.
- `name` (String) The name of the miner (maximum 30 characters). Changing this attribute will cause the miner to be dropped and recreated with a new ID.

### Optional

- `language` (String) Language localization code of the miner (e.g. 'en-US'). The API normalizes this to lowercase and assigns a default when omitted, so case differences are ignored and the computed value is accepted. Changing this attribute will cause the miner to be dropped and recreated with a new ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
